Fresh-open law fixed (dead seed: fullRepresentation created visible ⇒ onVisibleChanged never fired on first open). 7-config matrix green 2026-11-08 AM; CC build-gate adjudicated 2 accepts / 3 declines w/ code evidence. Harness gap: virtual-session light scheme ignored (Plasma bump) — app is token-only styling.
